faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a yacht charter in Marbella 2041?
faq.a: The maximum group size is 12 passengers on most of our larger yachts, including the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, and Ferretti 94. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (5 pax) have lower limits. Always check the specific boat's capacity when booking.

faq.q: Can I charter a boat for 15 people in Marbella?
faq.a: No, our fleet maximum is 12 passengers per vessel. For groups larger than 12, you would need to charter multiple boats. We can help coordinate a multi-boat itinerary from Puerto Banús so your whole party can cruise together.

faq.q: Are children counted in the group size limit?
faq.a: Yes, children of all ages are counted as passengers and included in the boat's maximum capacity. Safety regulations require that every person on board is accounted for, regardless of age. Life jackets are provided for all sizes.

faq.q: Which yacht in your fleet accommodates the most passengers?
faq.a: Several of our yachts accommodate up to 12 passengers, including the Mangusta 80 (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), and Ferretti 94 (29m). These are ideal for larger groups wanting space and comfort.

faq.q: What is the smallest group size I can charter for?
faq.a: You can charter a boat for as few as 1 passenger, though pricing is per boat not per person. The Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are great for small groups or couples. Minimum charter duration is 2 hours.

faq.q: Does the group size limit include the crew?
faq.a: No, the group size limit applies only to passengers. Our licensed skipper is not counted in the maximum passenger number. For example, on the Azimut 39, you have 11 passenger spots plus the skipper.

faq.q: Are there any extra costs for larger groups?
faq.a: No, our prices are per boat, not per person. A charter for 2 people costs the same as a charter for 12 on the same boat. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and IVA. The only exception is the Mangusta 80 which has a minimum 4-hour booking.

faq.q: Can I book a boat for a party or event with 12 guests?
faq.a: Yes, many of our yachts are perfect for celebrations. The Mangusta 80 (24m) and Ferretti 94 (29m) offer plenty of deck space for socialising. Just remember that the 12-passenger limit is strict for safety and insurance reasons.

data.body_html:
Planning a yacht charter in Marbella for 2041? One of the first things to check is the group size limit for your chosen boat. Whether you're organising a family outing, a corporate event, or a celebration with friends, knowing how many passengers can board is essential. Our fleet, based at Puerto Banús, offers a range of capacities from 5 to 12 passengers, ensuring there's a vessel for every group size. Below, we break down the limits, pricing, and what's included so you can book with confidence.

Maximum Group Size by Boat

All our yachts have a strict maximum passenger capacity, which includes adults and children. The skipper is not counted in this limit. Here's a quick overview of the capacities for our most popular boats:

  • 12 passengers – Mangusta 80 (24m), Mangusta 80 Grey (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Canados 86 (26m), Ferretti 94 (29m), K80 (24m), Maiora 26m (26m)
  • 11 passengers – Azimut 39 (12.5m)
  • 10 passengers – Fairline Targa 12m (12m), Pershing 46 (14m), Lagoon 380 (11.6m)
  • 9 passengers – Astondoa 40 (12.5m)
  • 6 passengers – Red Tide (11m), Speedboat (7m)
  • 5 passengers – Dubhe (8m), Mariah SX21 (6.4m)

For the full list of boats and their specs, visit our Marbella yacht charter page.

Why Group Size Limits Matter

Group size limits are not arbitrary—they're based on safety regulations, insurance requirements, and the boat's design. Exceeding the limit can void insurance and compromise safety. In Marbella, the Spanish maritime authority enforces these limits strictly. Always confirm the capacity before booking to avoid disappointment on the day. Our team can advise on the best boat for your group size.

Pricing for Different Group Sizes

Our pricing is per boat, not per person, so larger groups get better value. Here are the key rates:

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and 21% IVA. No hidden fees.

What's Included in Every Charter

Every booking comes with a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. You don't need to bring anything except sunscreen and a camera. The skipper handles navigation and can suggest the best spots along the Costa del Sol, from Cabopino to Estepona.

Tips for Large Groups

If your group is 12 or more, consider booking two boats. We can coordinate departures from Puerto Banús so you can cruise together. For groups of 8–11, the Azimut 39 or Mangusta 80 are excellent choices. For smaller groups, the Dubhe or Mariah SX21 offer a more intimate experience. Remember that all charters depart from Puerto Banús, so plan your transport accordingly.

Book Your 2041 Charter Today

Ready to secure your spot? Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on boats not listed in Tier A or B. Group size limits are strictly enforced, so book early to get the boat that fits your party perfectly. Explore our full fleet at Boat Rental Marbella.
